description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Str 15 or Dex 15, Base Attack Bonus +3

Benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style, you can perform a Takedown. Make either a grapple, trip or reposition combat maneuver as a full round action. Should you succeed at any of those maneuvers, you can immediately make a pin attempt as part of the maneuver.

system.requirements: Shinsect Riot Style, Str 15 or Dex 15, Base Attack Bonus +3
